content: When a BswMDeadlineMonitoringControl action is exe- cuted, the BswM shall call Com_EnableReceptionDM for each BswMEnabledDMP- duGroupRef , and call Com_DisableReceptionDM for each BswMDisabledDMP- duGroupRef . The ordering of these calls to Com is undefined.
